title: Sample-level genotype QC
description: Flag sample-level genotype defects and return a clean sample set. Scored on per-class F1, false removals, defect-severity ranking and runtime, so flagging everything is not a winning strategy.

title: Latent-factor-adjusted differential expression
description: Differential expression adjusted for latent structure. The naive analysis finds many latent-driven genes; the task rewards recovering the real contrast without removing true effects.

title: Cell-type annotation
description: Annotate cells against a labelled reference atlas at granular and major resolution. Scored on accuracy, macro-F1, adjusted Rand index and major-class accuracy.

title: Pseudobulk and cell-type composition
description: Aggregate sparse single-cell libraries into pseudobulk profiles and recover cell-type composition. Scored on composition distance, composition r-squared and pseudobulk correlation.

title: Cis-eQTL mapping with population structure
description: Map cis-eQTLs while controlling population structure and calibrating false discovery. Scored on power at a fixed FDR, calibration, effect accuracy and sign accuracy.

title: Co-expression network with latent confounders
description: Infer a co-expression network in the presence of latent confounders. Scored on direct-edge recovery, path recovery, sign accuracy and control of latent-driven false positives.

title: Confounder-adjusted GRN inference across replicates
description: A method task evaluated on five held-out replicates with different graph topologies, confounder strengths and latent density. Scored on the mean, with a variance penalty for unstable methods.

title: Cis-eQTL fine mapping
description: Build 95% credible sets and posterior inclusion probabilities from eQTL summary statistics and an LD panel. Scored on coverage, set size, PIP ranking and calibration.

title: eQTL-GWAS colocalization
description: Distinguish shared causal signal from coincidental overlap using eQTL and GWAS summary statistics. Scored on H0-H4 hypothesis accuracy, H4 F1 and posterior quality.

title: Functional annotation of variants
description: Classify variants by regulatory function from incomplete chromatin, conservation and motif tracks. Scored on macro-F1 and motif-disruption ranking, so a model must separate real signal from missing annotation.

title: Stratified heritability enrichment
description: Estimate stratified heritability enrichment across annotation categories and report calibrated uncertainty. Scored on enrichment error, share error and confidence-interval coverage.
